shared_block: Soft, warm children's storybook illustration — gentle painterly shading, rounded friendly shapes, cozy warm lighting. Ages 0-3: NO text in the image, square composition, soft uncluttered background, ONE clear subject, centered. Setting/objects read as ethiopia. FRIENDLY: any creature has a soft gentle smile, warm eyes, never scary. RENDER QUALITY: finish every surface; no melting or blank areas. TEXT-SAFE ZONE: keep the bottom ~18% calm (no key subject) for the word band.
